name: Sridhar
headline: Bridging the World of Circuits and Code
subHeadline: Electronics and Communication Engineering student exploring digital hardware, VLSI, embedded systems, and full-stack development — building practical ideas from signal to software.
bio:
I'm an Electronics and Communication Engineering student with a deep fascination for both hardware and software. My academic journey has given me a strong foundation in digital electronics, logic design, Verilog, and embedded systems — while my personal projects have pushed me into the world of full-stack web development, building real products with React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

What excites me most is the overlap: understanding how signals become data, how circuits become systems, and how systems become experiences. I'm driven to build things that work — from RTL descriptions of logic circuits to full-stack web applications.

Currently learning advanced VLSI design concepts while continuing to develop my skills in modern web technologies.
currentFocus: Exploring VLSI design and building full-stack web applications
